title: REPORT on the European Semester for economic policy coordination: employment and social priorities for 2025
part_text: 2. Calls on the Commission and the Council, in line with the Budapest Declaration on the New European Competitiveness Deal of 8 November 2024, to prioritise the reduction of bureaucratic and fiscal barriers affecting entrepreneurship, especially for small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and start-ups, which are essential for the EU’s economic growth and competitiveness, and thus for the financing of social policies;
